subject: Hospitality
title: The Global Rise of Boutique Hotels
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Global Rise of Boutique Hotels.

hook.text: Ian Schrager and Steve Rubell opened Morgans Hotel in 1984—small, stylish, and anti-chain. The boutique hotel category was born.

buildup.text: Boutique hotels offered personality: unique design, local character, and curated experiences.

discovery.text: The concept spread globally. By 2023, boutique hotels held 3% of rooms but commanded 20–30% rate premiums over comparable chains.

twist.text: Big chains noticed: Marriott created Autograph Collection, Hilton launched Curio. They buy boutique hotels and add loyalty points.

climax.text: True boutique hotels thrive by being genuinely local and owner-driven. Their future belongs to independents with unique stories.

punchline.text: Small, stylish, anti-chain. Boutique hotels proved that personality beats points programs.

quiz.question: What defined the original boutique hotel concept?
options: Small, stylish properties with unique design and anti-chain personality—started by Schrager in 1984
